description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Clan' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Clan - clans of the game for any genre: 4X alliances, midcore clans, casual teams. IsEnabled (empty = on) and Kinds: a map KindID -> kind; usually ONE kind with id 'clan' (then clients never pass KindID); a second kind (guild + club) is just another key. Each kind: Identity {NounKey - localization key of the word the player sees: Clan/Alliance/Guild/Team, DisplayName fallback, Icon}; Create {Gate (SegmentGate who may create), Price (PriceOption map: what creating costs, several payment options), NameMin/MaxLength (3/20), TagRequired, TagMin/MaxLength (2/5), DescriptionMaxLength/AnnouncementMaxLength (300), Emblem {Backgrounds, Symbols, Colors atlas keys}, Languages, Attributes (own clan attributes with allowed Values), RenamePrice, RenameCooldownHours, ReservedNames}; Membership {BaseCapacity (default 30), JoinModes (Open/Request/InviteOnly), DefaultJoinMode, JoinGate, ApplicationHours/InviteHours (72), MaxApplicationsPerPlayer (5)/PerClan (50), JoinCooldownHours (after leaving any clan), RejoinSameClanHours, TenureHoursForRewards (membership age before gifts and level rewards), MaxKicksPerDay (10)}; MemberStats {Power, Trophies: source PlayerLevel / CharacterLevel / CurrencyBalance (Key=CurrencyID) / Reported (the game reports it via CloudCode server.SetClanMemberStat), PowerTopN}; Roles {Roles: RoleID -> {Rank (higher = more power), NameKey, DisplayName, MaxCount, Permissions}, LeaderRoleID, DefaultRoleID, LeaderInactiveDays (leadership passes to the most senior active member)}; empty Roles = built-in leader/coleader/elder/member; built-in permissions: invite, manage_applications, kick, set_role, edit_info, edit_announcement, moderate_chat, create_request; any OTHER permission id is the game's own (e.g. start_rally) checked by the game via MyPermissions or server.HasClanPermission. Counters: CounterID -> {NameKey, Sources (TriggerSource list), Reset Never/Daily/Weekly, DailyCapPerMember} - own clan counters for rankings. Rankings {Metrics: Power, Level, Trophies, Members, counter:{id}; ByLanguage; ByRegion; PageSize}. Hooks: clan event (Created, Joined, Left, Kicked, RoleChanged, LeaderChanged, Updated, Donated, Helped, LevelUp, GiftCreated, Disbanded) -> CloudCode function name, run after the write. Progression {XpSources (TriggerSource list; events of members bring clan XP), DailyXpCapPerMember, Levels (explicit table; index 0 is LEVEL 2, level 1 needs 0 XP; each row RequiredXp, Capacity, RoleCaps, Perks: request_amount_percent, help_cap) or XpCurve/BaseXp/MaxLevel, CapacityPerLevel, LevelRewards (MilestoneDefinition list, RequiredProgress = clan level, every member present at that moment claims)}. Requests: RequestKindID -> {Type 'Resource' (members ask for a resource: Resources whitelist of VirtualCurrency or stackable Item with the asked Amount, Funding Donor (the donor pays) or System (free, like lives; SystemDailyCap per title per day), MaxPerDonor, DailyDonateCap, DonorReward per unit) or 'Help' (one tap help on the game's task key: MaxHelps, DailyHelpCap, DonorReward), Gate, CooldownMinutes, LifetimeHours, MaxOpenPerMember}. Gifts {Gifts: GiftID -> {Triggers (TriggerSource list, e.g. IapPurchase or StorePurchase of a member), Points (clan gift points), Content (ResourceGrant), ContentByLevel}, Levels (MilestoneDefinition list by gift points: gift levels and their rewards), LifetimeHours (72), ShowSender, IncludeSender}. A feature block left empty is off. Crypto and event tokens are never allowed in clan flows. Clan data of the game itself lives in DataCollections with the access rule Mode=Clan (ClanField = Indexed String field with the ClanID).

ClanActivityDefinition.description: A clan activity: Goal or Boss.

AttemptsPerDay.description: Boss: attempts per member per UTC day for client-reported damage (SubmitActivityScore). Empty = 3.

BossLevels.description: Boss: levels one after another; killing a level spawns the next. The last level stays dead.

ClaimGraceHours.description: Hours after the end during which rewards can still be claimed (the mailbox shows them live). Empty = 72.

ClaimMode.description: When tier rewards may be claimed. Empty = Instant.

ClanTiers.description: Goal: clan tiers, RequiredProgress = clan points. Rewards go to EVERY member with at least MinPersonalPoints.

DailyCapPerMember.description: Goal/Boss: most points (damage) one member may bring per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

DamageSources.description: Boss: server events that deal damage (BaseWeight = damage per event).

Gate.description: Who may take part (audience gate). null = every member.

LeagueRatingByTier.description: Goal: league rating the clan gets when it reaches a clan tier, key = MilestoneID of the tier (once per instance). Empty = activities do not move the league rating.

Manual.description: Officer start (when Schedule is empty): duration, price from the treasury, cooldown. Needs the 'start_activity' permission.

MaxDamagePerAttempt.description: Boss: most damage one client attempt may report (anti-cheat cap, like the leaderboard ClientScore gate). Empty = client attempts are off.

MinPersonalPoints.description: Goal: own points a member needs for clan tier rewards (Boss: own damage for kill rewards). Empty = 1.

NudgePoints.description: Goal: when the clan comes within this many points of the next tier, members who have not reached MinPersonalPoints yet get the push 'clan.goal_nudge' (once per tier and instance; the event must be set up in Push). Empty = no nudge.

PersonalTiers.description: Personal tiers: RequiredProgress = the member's own points (Goal) or damage (Boss).

PointSources.description: Goal: member events that give points (BaseWeight = points per event).

RequireMembershipAtStart.description: Only members who were in the clan when the instance started get rewards. Empty = false.

Schedule.description: Runs on this schedule for every clan (Cyclic / Scheduled / AlwaysOn). null = started by an officer (Manual).

Type.description: 'Goal' (one scale for the whole clan) or 'Boss' (shared HP). Unknown type = the activity is disabled.

CooldownHours.description: Hours between starts (from the previous start). Empty = 0.

MinClanLevel.description: Minimum clan level to start. Empty = any.

TreasuryCost.description: Start price in treasury currencies: CurrencyID -> amount. Empty = free.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the attribute name.

Required.description: Whether a clan must set it. Empty = false.

Values.description: Allowed values. Empty = free text up to 40 characters.

KillRewards.description: Reward for the kill to every member who dealt at least MinPersonalPoints damage in this instance.

ClanChatNoticesDefinition.description: System messages of a clan kind in its chat.

Events.description: Which clan events become a chat message. Empty = Joined, Left, Kicked, LeaderChanged, Donated, Helped, LevelUp, GiftCreated, ActivityTierReached, BossKilled, ProjectLevelUp, CompetitionFinished.

ClanCompetitionDefinition.description: A clan competition: Duel, Battle, League or War.

BracketSize.description: Clans per bracket. Duel and War are always 2. Empty = 20 (Battle) or 30 (League).

ClaimGraceHours.description: Hours after the end during which rewards can still be claimed (the mailbox shows them live). Empty = 72.

DailyCapPerMember.description: Most points one member may bring per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

Gate.description: Who may take part (audience gate). null = every member.

MatchByLeague.description: Put only clans of the same league into one bracket. League type always does. Empty = false.

MinClansPerBracket.description: A bracket with fewer clans at the end is 'no contest': no place rewards and no rating change (personal tiers still pay). Empty = 2.

MinMembers.description: Members a clan needs to enter. Empty = 1.

MinPersonalPoints.description: Own points (War: own stars) a member needs for the place reward. Empty = 1.

PersonalTiers.description: Personal tiers: RequiredProgress = the member's own points (War: own stars).

Phases.description: Phases in order (day themes of an Alliance Duel): each lasts DurationHours and has its own point sources. Empty = PointSources for the whole round.

PlaceRewards.description: Rewards by final place of the clan: every member with at least MinPersonalPoints gets the row of the clan's place. Rating moves the clan league rating (can be negative).

PointSources.description: Duel/Battle/League: member events that give clan points (BaseWeight = points per event). Used when Phases is empty or the phase has no own sources.

PowerBands.description: Clan power bands for matching, ascending thresholds (e.g. [10000, 50000] = three bands). Clans of different bands never meet. Empty = no power matching.

Registration.description: 'Auto' — a clan enters on its first point (or when any member presses Register); 'Officer' — a role with 'manage_competitions' registers the clan. Empty = Auto.

RegistrationHours.description: Registration is open only during the first N hours of the round. Empty = until the end.

Schedule.description: When the competition runs (Cyclic / Scheduled). Every instance is one round with its own brackets. null = the competition never runs.

Type.description: 'Duel' (2 clans by points), 'Battle' (bracket of up to BracketSize clans by points), 'League' (Battle inside one league, rating moves by place) or 'War' (2 clans, attacks on members, stars). Unknown type = the competition is disabled.

War.description: War only: attacks, stars, roster and where the attack result comes from.

PointSources.description: Events that give points in this phase. Empty = the competition's PointSources.

ClanCompetitionPlaceDefinition.description: Reward and rating for a range of places.

FromPlace.description: First place of the range (1 = winner).

Rating.description: League rating change of the clan (negative = down). Empty = 0.

Rewards.description: Reward for every eligible member of a clan with this place.

ToPlace.description: Last place of the range. Empty = FromPlace.

DailyCapPerMember.description: Most one member may add per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the counter name.

Reset.description: Reset period (UTC; weeks start on Monday). Empty = Never.

Sources.description: Game events that add to the counter (BaseWeight per event). Empty = only game code adds (CloudCode server.AddClanCounter).

Attributes.description: Custom clan attributes keyed by AttributeID ('playstyle', 'timezone'), each with its allowed values. Searchable.

Emblem.description: Emblem parts the player composes from. null = emblem is a free string ID chosen by the client.

Gate.description: Who may create a clan (audience gate: level, premium, segment). null = anyone.

Languages.description: Languages a clan may declare (codes like 'en', 'ru'). Empty = any.

Price.description: Creation price as payment options (PriceOption). Empty = free. A store purchase is not accepted.

RenamePrice.description: Price of renaming the clan (name or tag). Empty = free.

ReservedNames.description: Reserved names and tags nobody may take (case-insensitive, compared after normalization).

TagRequired.description: Whether a tag (short name like [ABC]) is required. Empty = false (tag optional).

MaxAllies.description: Most alliances of one clan. Empty = 3; 0 = alliances off.

MaxEnemies.description: Most declared enemies. Empty = 10; 0 = enemies off.

MaxPacts.description: Most non-aggression pacts. Empty = 5; 0 = pacts off.

ProposalHours.description: Hours a proposal waits for the answer. Empty = 72.

ClanEmblemDefinition.description: Emblem parts: the clan emblem is background + symbol + color, each picked from these lists.

Content.description: Content for each recipient. Items (lootbox items too) and virtual currencies only.

ContentByLevel.description: Content by clan gift level, key = level as string ('2', '3'). The highest key not above the clan's level wins; none = Content.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the gift name.

Points.description: Gift points the clan gets per gift. Empty = 1.

Triggers.description: What creates the gift: IapPurchase (ProductID filter), StorePurchase (OfferID filter), CustomAction etc. One matching event = one gift.

ClanGiftsDefinition.description: Clan gifts: a member's purchase or action gives every clanmate a gift.

Gifts.description: Gift kinds keyed by GiftID: what triggers them and what they contain.

IncludeSender.description: The buyer gets the gift too. Empty = false.

Levels.description: Gift levels: MilestoneDefinition.RequiredProgress = clan gift points. Gift level = 1 + number of reached milestones; their Rewards go to every member on reaching (pull model).

ShowSender.description: Show who triggered the gift. Empty = true.

DisplayName.description: Display name for the dashboard and as a fallback when the key has no translation.

NounKey.description: Localization key of the noun players see: 'Clan', 'Alliance', 'Guild', 'Team', 'Club'. Empty = 'clan.noun'. Client-side only: the clan screen translates and shows it, the server does not read it.

x-enum-descriptions: Anyone who passes the clan requirements joins at once.
The player applies, an officer accepts.
Only by an invitation from an officer.

ClanKindDefinition.description: A kind of clan: core blocks plus feature blocks. Each block is a dashboard tab.

Activities.description: Feature: clan activities keyed by ActivityID — Goal (the whole clan fills one scale with tiers, Team Chest) and Boss (shared HP, attempts per day, rewards for the kill and for personal damage). On a schedule or started by an officer. null = no activities.

ChatNotices.description: System messages in the clan chat ('Anna joined', 'Tom helped Anna', 'The clan opened a chest tier'): written by the engine into every Group chat channel of this clan kind after the action. The message carries the localization key 'clan.chat.{event}' (lower case) and parameters user/actor/target plus the event's own; Text is the English fallback. null = off.

Competitions.description: Feature: clan vs clan competitions keyed by CompetitionID — Duel (2 clans by points, day themes), Battle (up to 20 clans in a bracket), League (brackets by league, rating up or down by place), War (attacks on members of the other clan, stars; the result comes only from the server). On a schedule; brackets by league and power; rewards by place. null = no competitions.

Counters.description: Custom clan counters keyed by CounterID: which game events add to them and when they reset. Used by rankings and by game code (CloudCode server.AddClanCounter).

Create.description: Clan creation: who may create, price, name/tag rules, emblem parts, languages, custom attributes, renaming.

Diplomacy.description: Feature: diplomacy between clans of this kind — alliances and pacts (proposal + acceptance) and enemies (one-sided), with caps. Allies and pacts are never put into one competition bracket. null = no diplomacy.

Enabled.description: Kind switch. Empty = enabled. A disabled kind is hidden; its clans are kept.

Gifts.description: Feature: clan gifts — a member's purchase or action becomes a gift for every clanmate; gift level grows with gift points. null = no gifts.

Hooks.description: CloudCode handlers for clan events: event -> function name. Events: Created, Joined, Left, Kicked, RoleChanged, LeaderChanged, Updated, Donated, Helped, LevelUp, GiftCreated, Disbanded; stage 2: Deposited, TreasurySpent, ProjectContributed, ProjectLevelUp, ActivityStarted, ActivityTierReached, BossKilled, QuestCompleted, QuestsSelected; stage 3: CompetitionRegistered, CompetitionFinished, WarAttack, DiplomacyChanged. Runs AFTER the write through a queue, so a broken script never breaks the action. Parameters: Event, KindID, ClanID, UserID, ActorUserID, Params.

Identity.description: How players call this group (localization key of the noun), icon and order.

Leagues.description: Feature: clan leagues — tiers by clan league rating. Rating comes from competition places and Goal activity tiers; brackets of competitions with MatchByLeague are formed inside one league. null = no leagues (rating still counts).

MemberStats.description: Where member 'power' and 'trophies' come from and how clan power is aggregated.

Membership.description: Membership: capacity, join modes, application/invite lifetime, cooldowns, tenure, kick limits.

Progression.description: Feature: clan XP and level — XP sources, level thresholds, capacity and perks per level, rewards to every member for clan level-ups. null = no levels.

Projects.description: Feature: clan projects keyed by ProjectID (4X alliance tech, CoC Clan Capital): levels with point thresholds, accepted resources, daily contribution cap, what each level gives, dependencies. null = no projects.

Quests.description: Feature: clan quests keyed by BoardID, on the Quest module's models (QuestIdentity, QuestObjectiveDefinition, QuestReward). Modes: Shared (the whole clan pushes one goal), Board (a member takes a task, points go to the clan scale), PerMember (identical personal clan dailies). null = no clan quests.

Rankings.description: Which clan rankings are visible and their slices.

Requests.description: Feature: requests to the clan keyed by RequestKindID — Resource (ask clanmates for cards/lives/spins) and Help (one-tap help that speeds up a game timer). null = no requests.

Revenge.description: Board games (GameLoop): revenge. When an outsider attacks or raids a member on the board, the clan sees it with a 'Revenge' button; the member who takes it gets the offender as the target of their next board attack or raid, and the hit counts as the server source ClanRevenge (clan XP, Goal points, quests). null = off.

Roles.description: Roles and permissions keyed by RoleID. Empty = Leader / Co-leader / Elder / Member.

Treasury.description: Feature: clan treasury — clan-owned currencies, where they come from (game events, member deposits) and what they are spent on (projects, activity starts, clan-wide buffs). Journal of every movement. No payouts from the treasury to single players. null = no treasury.

IntervalSeconds.description: Season length in SECONDS (fixed-interval cycle from AnchorUtc, like other systems). Less than 3600 = no seasons. Example: 2419200 = 4 weeks.

KeepPercent.description: Percent of the rating earned above StartRating that the clan keeps into the next season (0-100). Empty = 50.

SeasonReward.description: Season reward for every member of a clan that finished the season in this league (Leagues.Season). Claimed by the member.

Season.description: League seasons: at the end of each season the clan's rating is softly reset and every member who was in the clan at the end may claim the SeasonReward of the league the clan finished in. null = no seasons (rating never resets).

StartRating.description: Rating a new clan starts with. Empty = 0.

Tiers.description: League tiers. A clan is in the highest tier whose MinRating it has. Order does not matter.

Capacity.description: Member capacity at this level. Empty = previous level's (or BaseCapacity).

Modifiers.description: Game perks of this level as modifiers (ModifierSource.Clan): applied by the server on reward and cost calculations of every member (board rewards, build cost) like a TimedBoost; Custom targets are returned to the game as-is.

Perks.description: Perks at this level, PerkID -> value. Built-in: 'request_amount_percent' (+% to request size), 'help_cap' (+helps per request). Other IDs are returned to the game as-is.

RequiredXp.description: Total clan XP needed for this level.

RoleCaps.description: Role caps at this level, RoleID -> max count. Overrides ClanRoleDefinition.MaxCount.

ClanMemberStatsDefinition.description: Member stats: snapshot of each member's power/trophies, refreshed when the member acts. Clan power lags behind by design.

Power.description: Source of member 'power'. null = no power.

PowerTopN.description: Clan power = sum of the top N members' power (CoC-style weighting is TopN + weights). Empty = all members.

Trophies.description: Source of member 'trophies'. null = no trophies.

BaseCapacity.description: Members a clan can hold at level 1 (or without Progression). Empty = 30. Levels may raise it.

DefaultJoinMode.description: Join mode of a new clan. Empty = Open.

JoinCooldownHours.description: Hours a player must wait after leaving (or being kicked) before joining ANY clan of this kind. Empty = 0. Royal Match uses 24.

JoinGate.description: Who may join at all (audience gate). Clan's own requirements (min power, min level) come on top. null = anyone.

JoinModes.description: Join modes the clan leader may choose. Empty = all three.

KickInactiveDays.description: Days without playing (the player's last activity in the game, not only in the clan screen) after which a member is removed from the clan automatically when anyone opens it. The leader is never removed: see Roles.LeaderInactiveDays. Empty = never.

MaxApplicationsPerClan.description: Open applications one clan may hold. Empty = 50.

MaxApplicationsPerPlayer.description: Open applications one player may have at once. Empty = 5.

MaxKicksPerDay.description: Kicks one officer may do per UTC day. Empty = 10. The leader is limited too.

NoBoardAttacksOnClanmates.description: Board games (GameLoop): clanmates and members of allied clans (Diplomacy Ally/Pact) are never picked as attack or raid targets. Empty = false (they may be picked like anyone else).

RejoinSameClanHours.description: Hours a player must wait before rejoining the SAME clan. Empty = 0.

SuggestJoinAfterHours.description: Hours after registration when the game should invite a player without a clan of this kind to join one (GetMyClans answers SuggestJoin = true). Empty = never suggest.

TenureHoursForRewards.description: Hours of membership before a member may claim clan rewards (gifts, level rewards). Stops hopping between clans for rewards. Empty = 0.

ClanPerkModifier.description: A clan perk as a modifier: target + operation + value, same semantics as a TimedBoost effect.

Tag.description: Tag for game code with Custom target and for debugging ('gold_rush').

Target.description: What the modifier changes. AllReward / AllCost hit every reward / cost calculation; Custom is for game code (returned in ClanView.Modifiers).

BaseXp.description: Base XP per level for XpCurve. Empty = 1000.

CapacityPerLevel.description: Extra capacity per level above 1 when no Levels table (or the level row leaves Capacity empty). Empty = 0.

DailyXpCapPerMember.description: Most XP one member may bring per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

LevelRewards.description: Rewards to EVERY member when the clan reaches a level (pull model: each member claims). MilestoneDefinition.RequiredProgress = clan level. Tenure rule applies.

Levels.description: Explicit level table; index 0 is level 2 (level 1 needs 0 XP). When set, XpCurve is ignored.

MaxLevel.description: Maximum level when no Levels table. Empty = 20.

XpCurve.description: XP needed to go from level N to N+1 when no Levels table: BaseXp scaled by this curve over N. Empty curve = BaseXp each level.

XpSources.description: Game events that give the clan XP (BaseWeight = XP per event). ClanDonation, QuestComplete, StorePurchase, CustomAction etc.

ClanProjectDefinition.description: A clan project: members (and the treasury) contribute points, levels give perks and rewards.

DailyPointsCapPerMember.description: Most points one member may contribute per UTC day (treasury contributions are not counted). Empty = no cap.

Inputs.description: What the project accepts and how many points one unit gives.

Levels.description: Levels; index 0 is level 1. RequiredPoints is the TOTAL project points needed for the level.

MinClanLevel.description: Minimum clan level to contribute. Empty = any.

Requires.description: Dependencies: ProjectID -> level that project must reach before this one accepts contributions.

RewardPerPoint.description: Reward to the contributor per point. Items and virtual currencies only.

ClanProjectInput.description: What a project accepts: a player resource or a treasury currency.

PointsPerUnit.description: Project points per one unit. Empty = 1.

Resource.description: Player resource (Type + ID). Amount is ignored.

TreasuryCurrencyID.description: Treasury currency (spent by a role with 'spend_treasury').

Modifiers.description: Game perks the level adds as modifiers (ModifierSource.Clan).

Perks.description: Mechanical perks the level adds (same IDs as clan level perks; values of all projects and the clan level are summed).

RequiredPoints.description: Total project points needed for this level.

Rewards.description: Reward to EVERY member who was in the clan when the level was reached (claimed in the clan rewards list).

AbandonCooldownMinutes.description: Board: minutes before a member who abandoned a quest may take another. Empty = 0.

ClaimGraceHours.description: Hours after the cycle end during which rewards can still be claimed. Empty = 72.

ClaimMode.description: When scale tier rewards may be claimed. Empty = Instant.

Gate.description: Who may take part (audience gate). null = every member.

MaxTakenPerMember.description: Board: quests one member may hold at once. Empty = 1.

MaxTakersPerQuest.description: Board: members who may take the same quest. Empty = unlimited.

MinPersonalContribution.description: Shared: own progress a member needs for a quest's reward. Empty = 1.

MinPersonalPoints.description: Own points a member needs for scale tier rewards. Empty = 1.

Mode.description: 'Shared' (one goal for the whole clan; reward to each member with a minimum personal contribution), 'Board' (a member takes a task and does it alone; points go to the clan scale) or 'PerMember' (identical personal clan dailies). Unknown mode = the board is disabled.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the board name.

PickCount.description: How many quests of the pool make the set of a cycle. Empty = the whole pool.

ScaleTiers.description: Clan scale tiers: RequiredProgress = clan points of the cycle. Rewards go to every member with at least MinPersonalPoints.

Schedule.description: Cycle of the board (usually Cyclic Daily / Weekly). Each cycle gets a new set of quests and a fresh scale.

Selection.description: 'Auto' (picked by the server, weighted by Weight) or 'Officer' (picked by the server, a role with 'select_quests' may replace the set while nobody has progress). Empty = Auto.

ClanQuestDefinition.description: A clan quest: the Quest module's display, objectives and reward. Objectives count server events only (Triggers); clients cannot push progress.

ClanXp.description: Clan XP for completing the quest (Shared: once; Board / PerMember: per member). Empty = 0.

Gate.description: Who may do it (audience gate). null = every member.

Objectives.description: Objectives keyed by ObjectiveID (Quest module model). Progress comes from Triggers (server events); MetricID / client progress is not used. The quest is done when all objectives are done.

Reward.description: Reward (Quest module model): Grant = personal reward; PointsReward = points into the clan scale (and the member's own points).

Weight.description: Pick weight in the pool. Empty = 1.

ByLanguage.description: Allow a by-language slice. Empty = true.

ByRegion.description: Allow a by-region slice (country from the server). Empty = true.

Metrics.description: Visible metrics: 'Power', 'Level', 'Trophies', 'Members', 'League' (league rating) or 'counter:{CounterID}'. Empty = Power and Level.

PageSize.description: Rows in a ranking page. Empty = 50.

x-enum-descriptions: The donor gives from own balance.
Nobody pays: the server mints the resource for the requester (daily title cap applies).

ClanRequestKindDefinition.description: A kind of request to the clan.

CooldownMinutes.description: Minutes between requests of this kind by one member. Empty = 0.

DailyDonateCap.description: Resource: most units one member may donate per UTC day across requests of this kind. Empty = no cap.

DailyHelpCap.description: Help: helps one member may give per UTC day. Empty = 50.

DonorReward.description: Reward to the donor per donated unit (Resource) or per help (Help). Items and virtual currencies only.

Funding.description: Resource: Donor = the donor pays from own balance (Clash Royale cards); System = free for donors, minted (Royal Match lives). Empty = Donor.

Gate.description: Who may create such requests (audience gate). null = any member.

MaxHelps.description: Help: helps one request can collect. Empty = 10. Clan perk 'help_cap' adds.

MaxItemLevel.description: Item: highest level of own item a member may ask a copy for. Empty = no cap.

MaxOpenPerMember.description: Open requests of this kind one member may have at once. Empty = 1 (Resource) / 5 (Help).

MaxPerDonor.description: Resource: most units one donor may give to one request. Empty = no cap.

MinMembershipHoursToDonate.description: Resource and Item: hours a member must have been in the clan before donating (against pumping from twin accounts). Empty = 0.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the request name.

Resources.description: Resource: what may be requested. Amount = how many one request asks for (clan perks may raise it). Items and virtual currencies only. Item: which unstackable items may be asked for (Amount = copies per request, empty = 1); empty list = any tradable unstackable item.

SystemDailyCap.description: Resource with System funding: most units the whole title may give out per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

Type.description: Request type: 'Resource' (ask for resources), 'Item' (ask for a copy of an unstackable item at the level of your own item, for upgrading by merge; donors give their own copy) or 'Help' (one-tap help on a game timer). Unknown type = the kind is disabled (an older engine never breaks on a newer config).

MaxPerMemberPerDay.description: Revenges one member may take per UTC day. Empty = 3.

WindowHours.description: Hours a revenge stays open (and a taken one waits for the next board attack). Empty = 24.

MaxCount.description: How many members may hold the role. Empty = unlimited (4X games cap R4 at 8). Clan level may raise it.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the role name.

Permissions.description: Permissions: built-in (invite, manage_applications, kick, set_role, edit_info, edit_announcement, moderate_chat, create_request) or the game's own IDs checked by game code (MyPermissions in responses, CloudCode server.HasClanPermission). Unknown IDs are just strings.

Rank.description: Seniority: higher = more senior. Officers act only on members of LOWER rank.

DefaultRoleID.description: RoleID new members get. Also used for members whose role was removed from config. Empty = the lowest-rank role.

LeaderInactiveDays.description: Days of leader inactivity after which leadership passes to the most senior active member when anyone opens the clan. Empty = 0 (never).

LeaderRoleID.description: RoleID of the single leader (all permissions, disband, transfer). Empty = the highest-rank role.

Roles.description: Roles keyed by RoleID (members store the RoleID, so ranks can be reordered). Higher Rank = more senior. Empty = leader / coleader / elder / member.

Key.description: Parameter of the source (CharacterID, CurrencyID, stat name).

x-enum-descriptions: Player level (PublicData.Level).
Character level; Key = CharacterID (empty = 'Main').
Virtual currency balance; Key = CurrencyID.
A value the game reports itself via CloudCode server.SetClanMemberStat; Key = stat name.

DailyDepositCapPerMember.description: Most treasury units one member may deposit per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

DailySourceCapPerMember.description: Most units one member's events may add per UTC day. Empty = no cap.

Deposits.description: Member deposits: the member pays own resources and the treasury gets units at these rates. Items and virtual currencies only.

Max.description: Treasury balance cap; income above it is lost. Empty = no cap.

NameKey.description: Localization key of the currency name.

Sources.description: Game events of members that add to the treasury (BaseWeight = units per event).

Currencies.description: Treasury currencies keyed by their own CurrencyID (a namespace of the clan, not player currencies).

LedgerDays.description: Days the treasury journal is kept. Empty = 30.

Purchases.description: What the treasury buys: clan-wide buffs (modifiers for every member for a while) keyed by PurchaseID. Bought by a role with 'spend_treasury'.

ClanTreasuryDepositRate.description: A deposit rate: Resource.Amount of the player's resource gives Gives treasury units.

Resource.description: Player resource to pay (Type + ID); Amount = units per one step.

Reward.description: Reward to the depositor per one step. Items and virtual currencies only.

ClanTreasuryPurchaseDefinition.description: A clan-wide buff bought with treasury currencies.

Cost.description: Price in treasury currencies: CurrencyID -> amount.

DurationHours.description: How long the buff lasts, hours.

MinClanLevel.description: Minimum clan level to buy. Empty = any.

Modifiers.description: Modifiers every member gets while the buff is active.

ClanWarDefinition.description: Clan war: attacks on members of the other clan.

AttackTimeoutMinutes.description: Server: minutes the server has to report a started attack; after that the attack counts with 0 stars. Empty = 30.

AttacksPerMember.description: Attacks per member per war. Empty = 2.

BattleRuleID.description: Battle: Match InstantBattle rule (stats, combat settings). Empty = the built-in 1v1 rule.

PreparationHours.description: Hours at the start of the round with no attacks (preparation). Empty = 0.

ResultSource.description: 'Server' — the game server reports stars via CloudCode server.ReportClanWarAttack; 'Battle' — the engine fights the attacker's character against the defender's at once (Match rule BattleRuleID), a win gives MaxStars. Empty = Server. The client never reports the result.

RosterSize.description: War roster: the strongest N members at registration. Empty = all members.

x-enum-descriptions: Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.
Android build (Google Play Billing).
iOS / iPadOS build (App Store, StoreKit).
Step: hold the previous point's value until the next one. Behaviour of an unset field.
Linear between adjacent points.
Geometric between adjacent points: lo * (hi/lo)^t.

CurvePoint.description: One breakpoint of a table curve.

AtStep.description: Step (level / rank / stage) at which this point takes effect. Empty = the point is ignored.

Value.description: Value at this point. Empty = the point is ignored.

x-enum-descriptions: Value does not change with the step. Same behaviour as an unset curve.
Additive in the value's own units: base + PerStep * (step - firstStep).
Additive share of the base: base * (1 + PerStepRate * (step - firstStep)). 0.1 = +10% of base per step.
Compounding: base * (1 + GrowthRate)^(step - firstStep).
Table of multipliers over the base: base * interpolate(Points, step).
Table of absolute values: interpolate(Points, step). The base is ignored.

CyclicSchedule.description: Calendar-aligned cycles with reset. Unified replacement of LeaderboardScheduleMode.Cyclic + LeaderboardCycleReset.

AnchorUtc.description: FixedInterval only: anchor instant (coerced to UTC, used as-is including time-of-day) from which IntervalSeconds windows are counted; the anchor defines alignment. null/unset = 2026-01-01 00:00 UTC. Ignored for calendar resets.

ClaimGraceHours.description: Grace window (hours) after cycle end to claim previous-cycle rewards. 0 = current cycle only.

IntervalSeconds.description: FixedInterval only: window length in SECONDS (e.g. 86400 = 1 day, 21600 = 6 hours, 864000 = 10 days). default = 86400 (1 day). Ignored for calendar resets.

PauseBetweenCyclesSec.description: FixedInterval only: pause (SECONDS) between active windows. 0 = back-to-back. When >0 the cycle 'pulses': active for IntervalSeconds, then a pause of this length (inactive during the pause — CanEarn=false/IsInPause), then the next window. Full period = IntervalSeconds + PauseBetweenCyclesSec. Ignored for calendar resets (they are gapless by definition).

x-enum-descriptions: Multiplier on board attack rewards.
Multiplier on board raid rewards.
Multiplier on rewards for passing start (GO) on the board.
Multiplier on the cost of building or repairing a structure.
Multiplier on rewards for completing a build/stage.
Multiplier on rewards for landing on a tile.
Multiplier on roll steps (more steps = move further).
Multiplier on quest completion rewards.

Generic "any reward" target: a modifier with this target applies at ALL reward calculation points regardless of the specific board target. Enables a single global "+200% earnings" boost. Boosts targeting AllReward are added on top of any reward target.
Generic "any cost" target: symmetric to AllReward but for cost calculations (build/repair cost, etc.). Applied at all cost calculation points.
Arbitrary modifier — the developer defines the semantics. Used together with CustomParams.

EventTokenAddress.description: Universal event-token address. Uniquely identifies the system and event the tokens belong to.

EntityID.description: Event identifier within the system. In TITLE CONFIG (rewards written by a designer or an AI agent) scheduled systems use the SHORT form — the cycle number is unknowable at config time: "{TimedEventID}" / "{LeaderboardID}" = whichever instance is active at grant time, or "{ID}:{ChainedEventID}" = that chain phase in the current cycle. The engine (EventTokenAddressResolver in ResourceService) expands it before granting; a grant with no active instance is dropped. At RUNTIME the bucket address is always the full form "{EntityID}:{InstanceKey}": TimedEvent Scheduled → "{TimedEventID}:s{yyyyMMddHHmm}"; TimedEvent Chain → "{chainID}:{cycleIndex}:{chainedEventID}"; Leaderboard → "{leaderboardID}:{instanceKey}"; CoopEvent → CoopChainID; Season → SeasonChainID.

EventTokenOperation.description: Information about granted event tokens. Returned in Board_Roll, QuestComplete and other responses. All multipliers (Roll/Premium/BonusWindow/ProgressiveTier/SeasonBuffs) are applied via ModifierService before ResourceService; this carries the final amount. Use ModifierApplyResult alongside ResourceOperation if UI needs multiplier breakdown.

Address.description: Event token address — where to grant or consume.

Amount.description: Token amount — how many to grant or consume.

Source.description: Operation source (sourceKey used for analytics and limits).

x-enum-descriptions: Landing on an EventToken tile on the board.
Passing start (GO) on the board.
Successful board attack.
Successful board raid.
Building or repairing a structure on the board.
Completing a board stage.

Completing a board Special mode — either via Instant choice or via Claim after the Timed window. Post-resolution source (mirrors BoardAttack/BoardRaid): fires at the final Special reward grant, separately from BoardTileLanding (which fires on the actual tile landing during Roll).
Completing a quest.
Store purchase.
Daily login.
Referral invite.
Token grant as a reward for a milestone or streak in another event. Server-only source — the client cannot invoke it directly.
Arbitrary action — the developer calls the server API with ActionName in Params.
Marketplace (v2) sale — deal settlement on the seller side. Server-only source. Filter Params: CatalogID / ItemID / OfferType.
Marketplace (v2) purchase — deal settlement on the buyer side. Server-only source. Filter Params: CatalogID / ItemID / OfferType.
In-game currency spend — any scenario where a resource operation actually consumed currency. Server-only source. The multiplier equals the amount spent. Filter Params: CurrencyID.
Opening a lootbox/chest. Server-only source. The multiplier equals how many boxes were opened in the call. Filter Params: LootboxID.

Real-money store purchase (IAP). Server-only source: fired in PurchaseV2 AFTER the receipt is verified and rewards are granted. The multiplier equals the number of product units granted. Filter Params: ProductID, Store. Deliberately separate from StorePurchase, which covers in-game currency spending.
Crypto deposit credited to the in-game balance. Multiplier is 1 (one operation). Filter Params: CurrencyID, NetworkID.
Crypto withdrawal CONFIRMED on chain. Multiplier is 1 (one operation). Filter Params: CurrencyID, NetworkID.
Spending crypto currency in-game. The multiplier equals the amount spent. Filter Params: CurrencyID.

In-game currency GRANT — mirror of CurrencySpent. The multiplier equals the amount granted, so ScaleWithRollMultiplier picks the meaning: "earn N currency" or "receive currency N times". Filter Params: CurrencyID and Origin ("Gameplay" | "RewardClaim"), the latter separating gameplay earnings from reward payouts — without it a goal like "earn N" would be closed by another quest's reward.
CRYPTO currency GRANT in-game (wallet deposits are NOT included — that is CryptoDeposit). The multiplier equals the amount granted. Filter Params: CurrencyID, Origin.

Leaderboard ScoreSources only: the board accepts the NUMBER the game submits itself (SubmitScore / SubmitScoresBatch). Not an event — it grants nothing and matches nothing, it only allows. Without it the board refuses a score from the game: an empty ScoreSources list means the board is not set up. Caps live in Limits: PerActivationCap = max score of ONE submission, DailyCap / DailyWeightCap = submissions / total score per UTC day, CooldownSeconds, MaxPerWindow + WindowSeconds, TotalCap = submissions for all time. A submission over a cap is refused, not trimmed. BaseWeight is not read. Set caps the game can really reach: the client is not trusted, they are the only limit on a forged score.
The player joined a clan (Clan section): by themselves, by application or by invitation. Params: KindID, ClanID. Use for a tutorial step 'join a clan', quests, event tokens.

The player helped the clan: donated to a request (Params.Kind = Request, weight = units) or helped a timer (Params.Kind = Help, weight = 1). Params: KindID, Kind, RequestKindID, ResourceID. Filter by Params.Kind.
The player claimed a clan gift. Params: KindID, GiftID.
The player upgraded an item (Item upgrade, batch included). Weight = levels gained. Params: ItemID, CatalogID, Level (the new level). Server-side only.
The player took revenge for a clanmate on the board (clan Revenge): an attack or raid on the offender of a taken revenge. Params: KindID, ClanID, Action (Attack / Raid). Server-side only.

ExperimentVariantCondition.description: Experiment-variant membership condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. The gate passes if the player is assigned to one of Variants of experiment ExperimentID (empty list = just enrolled). A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: make two configs (offer A, offer B), each gated to its variant.

ExperimentID.description: Experiment ID whose assignment is checked.

Variants.description: Allowed variants (any-of). Empty = being assigned to any variant is enough (enrolled). A player with no assignment for this experiment does NOT pass.

LimitSpec.description: Unified anti-farm limits ("how much / how often"). Replaces TriggerLimits (Scheduling), DealNodeLimitsDefinition (DealOffer), StoreOfferRules caps (Store) and ClaimRewardDefinition sliding fields (Reward). 0 on an axis = no limit. Superset of axes with DIFFERENT enforcement semantics: DailyCap/DailyWeightCap = calendar UTC day; MaxPerWindow/WindowSeconds = sliding window. Usually one set is filled per system, the rest = 0. Counters are stored/enforced by each system; this is config thresholds only.

DailyCap.description: Cap on triggers/actions per calendar day (UTC). 0 = no limit.

DailyWeightCap.description: Cap on weight (e.g. token amount) per calendar day (UTC). 0 = no limit.

MaxPerWindow.description: Sliding window: max triggers within WindowSeconds. 0 = disabled.

PerActivationCap.description: Cap within a single activation/session. 0 = no limit.

TotalCap.description: Lifetime cap per user. 0 = no limit.

WindowSeconds.description: Sliding-window length (seconds). Used only when MaxPerWindow > 0.

x-enum-descriptions: Claim instantly when the threshold is reached (accumulated progress >= RequiredProgress). Simplest, most predictable mode.
Claim only after the instance ends (within the system's grace window, if any). All milestones accumulate and are claimed in one batch. Motivates playing to the end.
Hybrid: regular milestones (IsFeatured = false) claim instantly; featured ones (IsFeatured = true) only after the instance ends.

MilestoneDefinition.description: Unified milestone primitive for all platform systems (TimedEvent, Leaderboard, Quest, CommunityChest, DealOffer). Replaces the per-module milestone definitions. Threshold is checked against accumulated progress (RequiredProgress): EventToken systems use EventTokenBalanceData.TotalEarned; CommunityChest uses shared group progress. Reward overlays BonusRewards (bonus-window) and SeasonTierRewards (season-tier) are platform-wide optional fields applied via MilestoneRewardResolver; leave null if unused.

BonusRewards.description: Bonus-window overlay: extra rewards on top of Rewards when the bonus phase is active at claim time (MilestoneRewardContext.BonusActive). Applied via MilestoneRewardResolver. null = no bonus part.

DisplayName.description: Display name for UI/CMS. null = unset.

IsFeatured.description: Featured milestone: special UI styling. With MilestoneClaimMode.FeaturedAfterEnd these can only be claimed after the instance ends.

MilestoneID.description: Unique milestone ID within its owning entity (Mongo-safe, claim idempotency key).

RequiredProgress.description: Threshold over ACCUMULATED progress to unlock. EventToken systems: EventTokenBalanceData.TotalEarned (not current balance). CommunityChest: shared group progress.

Rewards.description: Base rewards. Always granted on a successful claim.

SeasonTierRewards.description: Season-tier overlay: reward scaling by the player's season tier. Applied via MilestoneRewardResolver (SeasonTierRewardResolver.Resolve) only when MilestoneRewardContext.SeasonChainID is set. null = disabled.

SortOrder.description: Sort order in the UI (lower = higher/earlier).

x-enum-descriptions: Multiply the final value. Example: x2 from an event, x1.5 from a season buff. Applied as result *= value.
Percent added to the base value. Example: +50% = value 0.5 -> result += base * 0.5. All AddPercent sum BEFORE multiplication (additive stacking).
Fixed amount added to the base value (before multiplications). Example: +5 spins, +100 coins.

PremiumTierBonus.description: Percentage bonus on ResourceGrant.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 + Bonus) with Math.Ceiling rounding. Applies only to Standard; in Replace mode the bonused Standard is wiped when any PremiumTier matches. Best matching tier wins, bonuses do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierDiscount.

Bonus.description: Bonus as a SHARE: 0.1 = +10%, 1.0 = double (x2). Empty or 0 = no bonus. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PremiumTierBundle.description: Per-tier bundle describing a structurally different set of resources (different ItemIDs/tokens/currencies) available only to subscribers. Used in both ResourceGrant.PremiumTiers (rewards) and ResourceConsume.PremiumTiers (price). Differs from PremiumTierBonus/PremiumTierDiscount which only modify Standard Amounts by percentage.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

Resources.description: Items, currencies and tokens of this tier. Entries with Amount=0 are valid and mean 'skip'. Empty/null Resources in Consume.PremiumTiers means 'premium pays nothing' (equivalent to Discounts: 1.0).

PremiumTierDiscount.description: Percentage discount on ResourceConsume.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 - Discount) with Math.Ceiling rounding in player's favor. Applies only to Standard; ignored if PremiumTiers matches. Best matching tier wins, discounts do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierBonus.

Discount.description: Discount as a SHARE: 0.1 = -10%, 1.0 = free. Empty or 0 = no discount. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PriceOption.description: A single way to pay for an entity. Platform-wide standard: everything with a configured price describes it as a PriceOptions dictionary whose key is the OptionID. Options exist because ResourceConsume.Standard is charged as a whole (AND), while a price across platforms is a choice (OR): a store SKU on mobile, a token on web. Platform duties split as "the client renders, the server allows": title config ships as one immutable artifact per (version, field set), so it cannot be filtered per request — the client hides options by AllowedPlatforms, while PriceOptionSelector.Select refuses a charge whose option is not available on the caller's platform.

AllowedPlatforms.description: Platforms this option is available on. Empty/null = all of them. Do not list Unknown: a client that did not report its platform only gets options with no platform restriction, i.e. those safe everywhere.

AssetPaths.description: Option assets (currency icon, discount badge). Key = asset slug.

Cost.description: What is charged for this option. Standard is the base; PremiumDiscounts / PremiumTiers behave as everywhere else. An entry of type Purchase means the option is paid in a store rather than with a player resource: the payment is verified before ResourceService and never enters the resource operation. No initializer on purpose — "unset" must differ from "set to empty"; an unset Cost means the option is free.

Name.description: Display name of the option ("For gold", "$0.99"). A localization key or a literal — resolved client-side by the rule own table → fallback table → the key itself.

OptionID.description: Payment-option identifier. If empty, the dictionary key is substituted (PriceOptionResolver) — the client selects an option by this ID, so an option without one would be unselectable.

QuestIdentity.description: Display part of a quest. Analogous to CharacterIdentity: everything needed to draw it and nothing that affects the rules.

AssetPaths.description: Quest assets (task icon). Key = logical slot name.

CustomParams.description: Arbitrary client-side parameters: things the UI needs to draw that do not belong in the backend schema (localization key, day number, category tag, colour). The engine never interprets them.

Description.description: Quest description for UI. Usually shared by a batch of tasks — lives in a preset.

QuestObjectiveDefinition.description: Quest objective — a counter driven by exactly one mechanism, selected by Source: ClientApi/ServerApi advance it by the string key MetricID (client calls Quest/AddQuestProgress, server calls server.AddQuestProgress from CloudCode); SystemEvent advances it from the Triggers list, i.e. the same in-game events (TriggerSource) that feed TimedEvent tokens and leaderboard score — no HTTP call involved. Every field is optional: an objective may be a delta over the preset's objective, setting only TargetValue. An unset field is taken from the objective with the same ObjectiveID in the preset, and only then from the hard default (ClientApi / 0 / 1 / Sum).

MaxProgressPerCall.description: Delta cap for a SINGLE AddQuestProgress call. Applies to ClientApi only: exceeding it is treated as cheating and BANS the player (see QuestV2.AddQuestProgress) rather than silently clamping. Default 0 = no cap. For SystemEvent the step size comes from TriggerSource.BaseWeight.

MetricID.description: Metric key that contributes progress (e.g. "raid_win", "currency_spent"). Read ONLY when Source = ClientApi/ServerApi; matched exactly (Ordinal, trimmed). Ignored for SystemEvent.

ObjectiveID.description: Objective ID within the quest (e.g. "raid_wins"). Mongo-safe. Matches the dictionary key.

Source.description: Who advances the progress. Selects which field is read: MetricID (ClientApi/ServerApi) or Triggers (SystemEvent). Default ClientApi.

TargetValue.description: Required value to complete the objective. Default 1. This is the field an objective is normally overridden for on top of a preset.

Triggers.description: In-game events that advance this objective. Read ONLY when Source = SystemEvent. Same TriggerSource used by EventContent.TokenSources (TimedEvent) and LeaderboardDefinition.ScoreSources: event type + filters (tile, outcome, Params) + BaseWeight as the progress step per fire. Matched by the shared TriggerMatcher; the list is OR-ed. An empty list = the objective never advances.

QuestReward.description: Quest claim reward: the resource grant plus points into the cycle track.

Grant.description: Claim grant. Grant only — ResourceGrant, not ResourceOperation. Premium resolution runs in ResourceService against global cfg.Premium settings.

PointsReward.description: Points into the cycle track ("crown points") granted on quest claim. Default 0 = the quest gives no points. Backed by a Quest token (EventTokenType.Quest, EntityID "{cycleID}:{instanceKey}") inside the same atomic claim TX. Meaningful only for cyclic quests.

RelativeWindow.description: Window defined RELATIVE to the parent instance's start (see ScheduleMode.Relative). Window start = parent.StartUtc + OffsetSecondsFromParentStart. End = start + DurationSeconds, or (if DurationSeconds <= 0) the parent's end; never extends past the parent's end. Lets one config auto-repeat: sub-entity dates are computed from the current parent instance instead of being written absolutely.

AllowEarningAfterEnd.description: Whether progress can still be earned after the window ends (until grace ends). Default false.

ClaimGraceHours.description: Grace window (hours) after the window ends for claiming rewards. Default 0.

DurationSeconds.description: Window length in SECONDS. 0 (or less) = the window lasts until the parent's end (typical for "stage opens and stays until the event ends"). >0 = lasts exactly that long (but never longer than the parent).

OffsetSecondsFromParentStart.description: Window start offset in SECONDS from the parent instance start. 0 = open immediately with the parent. E.g. "Day N" = (N-1) * 86400.

ResourceBundle.description: Set of items, currencies and tokens for a single operation direction (grant only or consume only).

ResourceConsume.description: Consume direction container for ResourceOperation. Two mutually exclusive premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumTiers (priority) replaces Standard with the best matching tier's Resources via Replace, and PremiumDiscounts (fallback) applies a percentage discount to Standard only when no PremiumTier matched. Best matching tier wins, no stacking.

PremiumDiscounts.description: Percentage discount on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 - Discount)). Ignored if any PremiumTier matched — Replace takes over.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different price for premium players (different ItemID/CurrencyID/Target). Always Replace, single best matching tier wins. If matched, Standard is fully replaced and PremiumDiscounts is ignored; otherwise fallback to Standard + PremiumDiscounts.

Standard.description: Base — what to charge all players including F2P.

ResourceEntry.description: Universal container for a single entry in a resource bundle (item or currency). The set of populated fields depends on Type: Item uses CatalogID/ItemID/Amount; VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency uses CurrencyID/Amount; Purchase uses only ProductID (paid in a store).

Amount.description: Amount of the resource. Used by every type except Purchase, where the quantity is decided by the store itself and this field is ignored. Amount=0 is valid in Consume.PremiumTiers and means 'do not charge'.

AmountUsd.description: CryptoCurrency only: the amount in USD instead of a token count. At the moment of the operation the engine converts it to tokens at the LIVE market price of the token (charge: rounded up to a whole token; grant: rounded down). When set, Amount is ignored; the operation result carries the converted Amount.

CatalogID.description: Item catalog identifier. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs (e.g. "main", "season").

CurrencyID.description: Currency identifier. Used only when Type is VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies or cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

ItemID.description: Item identifier within the catalog. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs[Catalog].Items.

ProductID.description: IAP product identifier. Used only when Type is Purchase. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Purchase.Products — OUR stable product ID, not the store SKU (per-store SKUs live in IapProductDefinition.StoreProductIDs).

Type.description: Resource type. Determines which fields must be populated: Item (catalog item), VirtualCurrency (off-chain), CryptoCurrency (on-chain), or Purchase (real-money payment in a store).

x-enum-descriptions: Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

Payment in Credits, the PLATFORM currency on the player's iDos Games account (players see it as "Aspis" — write Aspis in player-facing text). Requires only Amount — the price in whole Credits. Like Purchase it is NOT a player resource and never enters ResourceService: it is settled by PlatformCreditsPayment in the same transaction as the grant (buyer charged, author credited). Accepted by every sale of the game author: Store, Lootbox, Collection packs, Craft, DealOffer, TimedBoost, Premium, Item and Character upgrades, skins, CoopEvent spins, GameLoop special mode entry, Workshop publish fee, InApp AI (charged only when the generation is ready). NOT accepted in player-to-player prices or refundable fees (Marketplace listing fee, PvP Match creation) - those refuse with CREDITS_NOT_ALLOWED_HERE; batch calls refuse too. Allowed only in Consume: Credits are never a reward anywhere.

ResourceGrant.description: Grant direction container for ResourceOperation. Two independent premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumBonuses applies a percentage uplift to Standard (single best tier wins, no stack), and PremiumTiers provides structurally different rewards governed by cfg.Reward.TierRewards (Additive or Replace mode; in Replace the bonused Standard is wiped). Both mechanisms can be used together or independently.

PremiumBonuses.description: Percentage uplift on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 + Bonus)). Wiped under Mode=Replace if any PremiumTier matches.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different rewards for premium players (different ItemID/Target/...). Governed by global cfg.Reward.TierRewards.RewardMode (Additive/Replace) and RewardStackLowerTiers.

Standard.description: Base — what to grant to all players including F2P.

ScalarCurveSpec.description: Scalar curve f(base, step): how a value grows with a level, rank, stage or count. THE MODULE'S RULE: an empty field does nothing — an unset curve is the identity f(base,n)=base, an unset bound means there is no bound. All rates are shares (0.1 = +10%), never multipliers, so 0 and empty always mean the same thing.

Base.description: Base the curve is computed from. Empty = use the base supplied by the caller. Fill it only where the base is a publisher setting (a multiplier starting at 1.5, a table's value before its first point) — where the base comes from data (a stat value, a level price, an item bonus) leaving it empty is required, otherwise it overrides the real base.

GrowthRate.description: Compounding rate per step (Shape=Geometric): 0.1 = x1.1 per step. Empty or 0 = no growth.

Interpolation.description: How to interpolate between points. Empty = Step.

MaxResult.description: Upper bound of the result. Empty = there is NO upper bound (not 0).

MinResult.description: Lower bound of the result. Empty = there is NO lower bound (not 0).

PerStep.description: Units added per step (Shape=PerStep). Empty or 0 = no growth.

PerStepRate.description: Share of the base added per step (Shape=PerStepRate): 0.1 = +10% of base per step. Empty or 0 = no growth.

Points.description: Table breakpoints (Shape=Table or TableAbsolute). Empty = no growth.

Shape.description: Curve shape. Empty = Flat, i.e. no growth.

TailGrowthRate.description: Growth beyond the last table point (share per step). Empty = hold the last point's value.

ScheduleChain.description: Recurring phase chain. Holds ONLY chain timing — the phase list lives on the module (a phase composes ScheduleChainPhase + its payload), so the resolver takes a projected IReadOnlyList<ScheduleChainPhase>. Unified replacement of the schedule parts of EventChainDefinition / LeaderboardChainConfig / BoostChainDefinition / CoopEventChainDefinition / SeasonChainDefinition.

AnchorUtc.description: Anchor date (UTC). The first phase of the first cycle starts here; all subsequent dates are computed from the anchor + phase durations + pauses. null = no anchor → the chain is unconfigured and never resolves.

MaxCycles.description: Maximum number of full cycles. 0 = infinite.

PauseBetweenCyclesSec.description: Pause between full cycles (seconds). 0 = no pause.

PauseBetweenPhasesSec.description: Pause between phases inside one cycle (seconds). 0 = no pause.

x-enum-descriptions: Active whenever enabled, no time gate (eternal leaderboard, manual boost).
Single fixed window [StartUtc..EndUtc] (see ScheduledWindow).
Recurring ordered list of phases (see ScheduleChain).
Activated/granted when a source fires (see ScheduleSpec.ActivationTriggers).
Calendar-aligned cycles with reset (see CyclicSchedule).

Window defined RELATIVE to the parent instance's start (see RelativeWindow). Resolved only when a parent is passed to ScheduleResolver.ResolveActive. Enables staged unlocking of sub-entities inside a recurring event (e.g. "Day N opens (N-1)x24h after the current cycle instance start"), so one config auto-repeats without absolute dates.
Every CyclicSchedule.IntervalSeconds seconds from CyclicSchedule.AnchorUtc — a fixed interval, not calendar-aligned (e.g. "every 6 hours" or "every 10 days"). Alignment is defined by the anchor.
No reset — eternal (all-time) instance.

ScheduleSpec.description: "How an entity activates" container, embedded into each system's definition. Exactly one sub-field is filled for the chosen Mode (plus ActivationTriggers for Triggered). Resolved via ScheduleResolver.

ActivationTriggers.description: Sources that cause activation/grant. Required and used only when Mode = Triggered. Matched via TriggerMatcher.

Chain.description: Chain config. Required and used only when Mode = Chained.

Cyclic.description: Calendar-cycle config. Required and used only when Mode = Cyclic.

IsActive.description: Unified global on/off. false = entity paused without deleting config (replaces scattered IsActive/Enabled).

Mode.description: Activation mode. Determines which sub-field is used.

Relative.description: Relative-window config. Required and used only when Mode = Relative.

Scheduled.description: Single-window config. Required and used only when Mode = Scheduled.

ScheduledWindow.description: Single fixed-date window. Unified replacement of the schedule parts of ScheduledEventDefinition / LeaderboardScheduledConfig / ScheduledBoostDefinition.

AllowEarningAfterEnd.description: Whether progress can still be earned after EndUtc (until grace ends). Default false.

ClaimGraceHours.description: Grace window (hours) after EndUtc for claiming rewards. Default 48.

EndUtc.description: Window end (UTC). After this, earning stops unless AllowEarningAfterEnd. null = unset -> the window is unconfigured and never active.

StartUtc.description: Window start (UTC). The entity is active from this moment. null = unset -> the window is unconfigured and never active (BOTH bounds are required).

SeasonTierRewardBundle.description: Structurally different rewards for a season-chain tier. Analogous to PremiumTierBundle but the trigger is the player's season tier. Selection picks the single best match (MinSeasonTier <= playerTier); not stacked.

MinSeasonTier.description: Minimum player season tier required for this bundle to apply. Matches SeasonTierDefinition.Tier / UserSeasonState.CurrentTier.

Rewards.description: Rewards for this tier. Passed unmodified into ResourceService via a regular ResourceOperation.Grant.

SeasonChainID.description: SeasonChainID this tier is linked to. Selection matches only tiers with the same SeasonChainID.

SeasonTierRewardMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to Amount of the base ResourceGrant for a season-chain tier. Applied to every ResourceEntry.Amount and EventTokenOperation.Amount in Standard and in PremiumTiers.Resources.

MinSeasonTier.description: Minimum player season tier required for this multiplier to apply.

Multiplier.description: Multiplier. 1.0 = neutral (resolver returns the base reward without copying). Rounding: (long)Math.Round(Amount * Multiplier). Entries with final Amount <= 0 are dropped.

SeasonChainID.description: SeasonChainID this tier is linked to.

SeasonTierRewardSet.description: Generic container of season-tier reward scaling. Used by any platform system (leaderboards, lootboxes, shop, daily) that wants to scale a ResourceGrant by the player's current tier in a season chain. Empty/null lists = neutral.

Bundles.description: Structurally different rewards for specific tiers. On match, replaces the base ResourceGrant entirely (Replace).

Multipliers.description: Multipliers applied to Amount of the base ResourceGrant. Used ONLY if no Bundles entry matched.

SegmentClanCondition.description: Gate condition on the player's clan. All fields are AND-ed; an empty field = no restriction.

InClan.description: true = must be in a clan of the kind; false = must NOT be in one. Empty = true when any other field is set, otherwise no restriction.

KindID.description: Kind of clan (KindID). Empty = the default kind.

MinMembershipHours.description: Hours in the clan at least. 0 = no restriction.

Permission.description: The member's role must have this permission (built-in or the game's own). Empty = no restriction.

RoleIDs.description: The member's role must be one of these RoleIDs. Empty = any role.

SegmentGate.description: Unified "who it is available/applies to" gate. Replaces BoostSegmentGate (TimedBoost), MailboxSegmentDefinition filters and StoreOfferRules premium fields. All conditions are AND-ed. An empty/unset field = no constraint on that axis; an empty/null gate = available to everyone. Resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

ActiveWithinDays.description: Active within the last X days (matches Usage.LastActiveAt). 0 = no restriction.

Clan.description: Clan condition (clans, stage 2): in a clan or not, clan level, role, membership age, a role permission. null = not applied. Read from the player's clan snapshot of the request, not from the player document; outside a client request the condition fails closed.

Countries.description: Country filter (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; matches PublicData.Country, else RegistrationCountry). Empty = all countries.

Experiment.description: A/B experiment condition: the gate passes only if the player is assigned to the required variant (ExperimentVariantCondition). null = not applied. A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: two configs, each gated to its variant. Assignment is read from UserDataDocument.Experiments (sticky, stable-hash — see ExperimentAssigner).

MaxLevel.description: Maximum Board Rank. 0 = no upper bound.

MinLevel.description: Minimum Board Rank (matches PublicData.BoardRank). 0 = no lower bound.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum active premium tier (matches Premium.MaxActiveTier). 0 = no requirement.

Platforms.description: Platforms the entity is available on. Empty/null = all. Unlike the other axes this one comes from the request platform (IGSService.ClientPlatform), not from the player document, and is passed to SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes as a separate REQUIRED argument. The axis is skipped when the platform is Unknown — deliberately soft, because it governs what is shown, not what is charged: payments are guarded by PriceOptionSelector.IsAvailableOn, where Unknown does not pass a non-empty platform list. Not needed to hide entities that simply cannot be paid for on a platform: storefronts already drop whatever has no available price option.

RegisteredWithinDays.description: Registered no earlier than X days ago (new players; matches RegistrationDate). 0 = no restriction.

RequiredPremiumIDs.description: Required active premium IDs (ANY of the list is enough, via PremiumHelpers.GetActivePremiumIDs). Empty = no requirement.

Segments.description: Allowed economy segments (matches PlayerEconomyTuningState.Segment: "F2P","Dolphin","Whale","VIP"). Empty = any.

Tutorial.description: Tutorial condition: the gate passes only if the player is in the required progression state (TutorialGateCondition). null = not applied. By the same trick as Experiment, this gives "after onboarding" gating in every module already using SegmentGate, with no edits to them. To close a whole module there is a cheaper path — TutorialGlobalSettings.Blocking: one check in ClientRun instead of a condition on every entity.

TriggerSource.description: Unified trigger source: which game event grants progress/grant and under which filters. Replaces EventTokenSource (TimedEvent), LeaderboardScoreSource (Leaderboard) and BoostTriggerSource (TimedBoost). SourceType reuses the existing EventTokenSourceType. Matched via TriggerMatcher.

BaseWeight.description: Base "weight" per trigger: token amount (TimedEvent) or score (Leaderboard). Unifies the former BaseAmount/BaseScore. Unused for TimedBoost triggers (a boost has no quantity).

ChanceOutcomeFilter.description: Only for SourceType = BoardTileLanding on Chance tiles. Whitelist of ChanceOutcome.OutcomeID values. Case-insensitive. Works in AND with TileTypeFilter/TileIndexFilter. Empty/null = not applied.

Limits.description: Anti-farm limits of the source — unified LimitSpec (per-day weight cap DailyWeightCap, per-day trigger cap DailyCap, CooldownSeconds). null = no limits (e.g. leaderboards intentionally apply none).

OutcomeFilter.description: Only for SourceType = BoardAttack / BoardRaid / BoardBuild. Whitelist of outcomes. Empty/null = any. BoardAttack: ["HIT"]/["BLOCKED"]; BoardRaid: ["FINISHED_SMALL"]/["FINISHED_MEDIUM"]/["FINISHED_BIG"]; BoardBuild: ["BUILD"]/["STAGE_COMPLETE"].

Params.description: Context parameters for filtering/identifying the source. CustomAction: {"ActionName":"watch_ad"}. QuestComplete: {"QuestID":"win_5_raids"} and/or {"CycleID":"daily"}. StorePurchase: {"OfferID":"starter_pack"}. MarketplaceSell/MarketplaceBuy: CatalogID / ItemID / OfferType. An unset or empty parameter means "any". Keys not listed here are not checked by the matcher.

ScaleWithRollMultiplier.description: Whether BaseWeight scales with the player's RollMultiplier. true: Weight = BaseWeight x M_roll. false: fixed amount.

SourceType.description: Source type. Identifies which game event fires.

TileIndexFilter.description: Only for SourceType = BoardTileLanding. Whitelist of tile indices. Empty/null = any index. Works in AND with TileTypeFilter.

TileTypeFilter.description: Only for SourceType = BoardTileLanding. Whitelist of tile types (BoardTileType names or CustomTypeID) that fire on landing. Case-insensitive. Empty/null = any tile (not recommended).

TutorialGateCondition.description: "The player finished the tutorial" condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Tutorial exactly as ExperimentVariantCondition is embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. Thanks to that, tutorial gating works for free in EVERY module already using SegmentGate (Store / DealOffer / Quest / Reward / Leaderboard / ...). This is the per-entity gating level; to close a whole module use TutorialBlockingPolicy, which is cheaper.

FlowIDs.description: Flows whose state is checked. Empty = the condition is not applied (the gate passes). Multiple entries are AND-ed: "after the intro AND after the raid tutorial".

Mode.description: What exactly must hold for those flows. Default Completed.

Negate.description: Invert the condition. Needed for the reverse case — "show this starter offer ONLY to players still in the tutorial". Default false.

SkippedCountsAsCompleted.description: Whether a Skipped flow counts as finished under Mode = Completed. Default true: if the publisher allowed skipping, the skipper must get the same game as the completer.

StepID.description: The step that must be reached. Read only when Mode = StepReached, and applied to every flow in FlowIDs.

x-enum-descriptions: The flow is finished. Default.
The flow is started (in progress or already finished).
A specific step has been reached (TutorialGateCondition.StepID).

value.description: Title clans: 4X alliances, midcore clans, casual teams. Core (kinds, creation, membership, roles, counters, rankings) plus pluggable features (Progression, Requests, Gifts) — a feature is on when its block is set. The word the player sees (Clan / Alliance / Guild / Team) comes from Identity.NounKey of the kind.

IsEnabled.description: Module switch. Empty = enabled (a set section means the title has clans).

Kinds.description: Kinds of groups keyed by KindID (Mongo-safe). Usually one kind, then it is invisible: clients omit KindID. A second kind (guild + club) is added by config. Empty = one kind 'clan' with default settings. A player can be in one clan of EACH kind.

RefreshSeconds.description: How often the clan screen refreshes itself, seconds (sent by the server, clients obey it). Empty = 30.
